documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for BOARD MEETING TO BE HELD ON 04.11.2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Thangamayil Jewellery Limited reported a strong financial performance for the financial year 2025-26, driven by an organic revenue growth of 73% and significant contributions from newly operated Chennai retail outlets. EBITDA reached Rs. 57,674 lakhs and Profit After Tax (PAT) improved to Rs. 35,165 lakhs, despite escalating expenses from expansion. The total live customer base increased to 45 lakhs, and the employee count grew to 3,450.

guidance.claim: Management plans to nearly double the top line in the next four years.
guidance.quote: Plan to nearly double the top line in the next four years that took us 25 years to be where we are now.

guidance.claim: The company's customer base is slated to increase to 40 Lakhs by 31/03/26.
guidance.quote: Excellent Customer base built over period of years up to 32 Lakhs numbers and slated to increase to 40 Lakhs by 31/03/26

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the overall size of the market in volume terms is shrinking modestly alongside unhealthy competition.
demand_outlook.quote: Continued unhealthy competition prevailing in the market as the over all size of the market in volume terms shrinking modestly.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed that a steep increase in gold price restricts sales because customers are uncertain about price sustenance.
demand_outlook.quote: The adverse impact on vertical rise in gold price restricts the sale by the company as customers are not sure about the sustenance of price

orders_capacity.claim: Retail space increased by 17.46% to reach 104,000 sq ft.
orders_capacity.quote: Retail Space (increases by 17.46%) 104000 sq ft 88000 sq ft

orders_capacity.claim: Maximum operational retail space exceeded 1,00,000 sq.ft in February 2025.
orders_capacity.quote: Maximum operational Retail space exceeded 1,00,000 sq.ft (February 2025)

capital_allocation.claim: The company issued a Rights Issue raising a gross amount of 510,000 lakhs (51,000 lakhs) to fund retail outlet expansion and working capital requirements.
capital_allocation.quote: The Rights issue, gross amount of 5,10,000 lakhs was taken to reserves net of issue expenses of 224 lakhs and the consolidated Net Worth post merging of operational results of 24-25FY currently stands at 1,10,235 lakhs

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of Rs. 6 per share of face value of Rs. 10, making a total distribution of Rs. 10 per share for FY24.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board after considering the funding requirements for 2024-25 both for capex and enlarged working capital requirements due to gold price increase by 12%, has recommended a final dividend of ` 6/- per share of face value of Rs.10/- aggregating to Rs.10/- per share as total distribution of dividend for the financial year 2023-24 on the doubled equity capital.

risks_headwinds.claim: An extraordinary shift is taking place among the younger population toward other discretionary spending.
risks_headwinds.quote: Extra ordinary shift is taking place among younger population for other discretionary spending.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company noted continued unhealthy competition prevailing among both unorganised and organised players.
risks_headwinds.quote: Continued unhealthy competition prevailing both in unorganised and organised players.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to nearly double the top line in the next four years.
management_commitments.quote: Plan to nearly double the top line in the next four years that took us 25 years to be where we are now.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to open a flagship Chennai outlet by January 2025.
management_commitments.quote: To open flagship Chennai outlet by Jan 2025.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to complete geographical expansion in an additional 9 outlets as approved by the Board.
management_commitments.quote: To complete geographical expansion in additional 9 outlets as approved by the Board.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets to further improve the high value product-mix composition by 2% to 10% on overall sales.
management_commitments.quote: Further improve the high value product-mix composition by 2% to 10% on overall sales

management_commitments.claim: The company targets to improve stock turnaround from 3.52 times to 3.75 times.
management_commitments.quote: Improve the stock turnaround from 3.52 times to 3.75 times.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to improve the gross profit margin from 9.64% to 10% on price rationalisation.
management_commitments.quote: Improve the gross profit margin from 9.64% to 10% on price rationalisation.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims for same store sales improvement of at least 10% over and above the current level.
management_commitments.quote: SSS improvement at least by 10% over and above current level.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
